verdict.rationale: Galileo ships an official open-source Python SDK (galileo-python on GitHub) used throughout dozens of first-party cookbooks (LangChain, LangGraph, Stripe agent, RAG, weather-vibes app) with decorators, distributed tracing via OTel, and dataset/experiment APIs, showing a mature, actively-used SDK ecosystem. missing for 10: evidence of additional official SDKs (e.g., JS/TS) beyond Python, and independent (non-vendor) developer confirmation of SDK reliability.
